locations.note: Lara's hunt for the first meteorite artefact opens in the Indian jungle, among ruined temples.
In Nevada Lara crosses a desert canyon toward Area 51 and is taken prisoner.
In London Lara reaches the cosmetics boss Sophia Leigh in her office and takes the Eye of Isis.
Lara crosses island villages and a crash site, then infiltrates a temple to defeat the deity Puna and take the Ora Dagger.
The meteorite crater and the ancient city of Tinnos lie under RX-Tech's Antarctic base.
Inside Area 51 the fourth artefact, Element 115, sits in an alien spacecraft guarded by the US government.
The training level at Lara's home.

routes.name: The meteorite artefacts
routes.note: Lara gathers the meteorite artefacts from the Indian jungle across the South Pacific, London and the Nevada desert to the crash site in Antarctica.
